formulations.hero.title: A great cosmetic product starts with the right formulation
formulations.hero.description: Explore example formulations featuring ingredients from the MEDICOS portfolio. Discover the role of each ingredient and find inspiration for developing your own cosmetic products.
formulations.steps.description: Start with the type of cosmetic product you want to create or an ingredient you are interested in. See how example formulations combine ingredients from different manufacturers in the MEDICOS portfolio and what role each ingredient plays.
formulations.steps.step1-description: Review the formulation concepts. Consider the product type, texture and role of each ingredient.
formulations.steps.step2-description: Go to the product pages and select the ingredients you would like to learn more about.
formulations.steps.step3-description: Ask for samples, documentation, ingredient availability or a complete base formulation.
formulations.steps.note: These are example formulation concepts. Ingredient selection, compatibility, concentrations, the manufacturing process and final product properties must be verified in the laboratory.

formulations.cta.title: Can't find the formulation you're looking for?
formulations.cta.description: Tell us what type of cosmetic product you are developing and what results you want to achieve. We will review the available options and help you select suitable ingredients from the MEDICOS portfolio.
formulations.form.title: What would you like to create? Send us your project enquiry
formulations.form.description: Tell us about the cosmetic product you are working on. In a single enquiry, you can select several ingredients and formulations, and we will provide you with a complete formulation, samples or documentation.
formulations.form.next-title: What happens after you submit your enquiry:
formulations.form.next1: A response to your enquiry within a maximum of 3 working days
formulations.form.next2: Direct contact with a MEDICOS account manager or formulation technologist
formulations.form.next3: Samples and documentation with no obligation to purchase
